name: Content Placeholder 2
text:
Across 7,876 HITL teleforms: box-only changes 16.5%; sentence-only 20.9%; both 7.1%; no short-answer character changes 55.6%.

BOX-LETTER — substitutions dominate: one symbol is read as another.
SENTENCE — insertions and deletions dominate, often from joined or unclear handwriting.
